$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target and how to read it.

root.$why: Figma's Bubble frame has a 4 px gap for its Reactions slot; the code positions reactions absolutely, so the wrapper has no gap or padding of its own.

reactions-pill.$why: Figma lays the 0.5 px inside border out around its 6 px padding (39 px wide for 26 px of reactions); the code adds the half pixel to the padding instead, so the size matches and the padding reads 6.5. The gap applies between reactions (Figma's sample has one text node).

Reaction.$why: The component samples 13 px reactions while every demo uses 14 px; the code follows the demos.
